_comment: Copy this file to custom_roles.json and edit it. It uses the same schema as
roles.json and is merged last, so an entry can add a homebrew character or
replace an official one (for example to swap in your own art).
image            - a URL, or a local PNG path relative to this file.
Leave it out for a text-only token.
color            - blue / red / purple / yellow / green, or any #RRGGBB.
Keys starting with _ are ignored. "_Beacon" below shows a role with local
art: put your PNG at custom_art/beacon.png, then rename the key to "Beacon".
A local image that does not exist stops the build with an error.
